text:
miguel: Quick sync — we spun up model-14b-v2 int8 on a small fleet. Need a concise cost-vs-quality recommendation for Product/GTN so they can pick defaults and pricing.
anya: Can you paste the eval scorecard? key dims: instr-follow, QA accuracy, hallucination rate, embedding drift, latency, and token-unit cost.
eval-bot: automated eval summary:
- eval_id: 2026-11-03-14b-v2-int8
- instr-follow: 88% (fp16 baseline 92%)
- QA EM: 74% (fp16 77%)
- hallucination alerts: +1.1% absolute
- embedding cos-sim avg drop: 3.6%
- latency p95: 210ms (fp16 150ms)
- infra unit cost (est): $0.0029 / 1k tokens (batch size=8)

sam: Econ TL;DR: int8 cuts infra $/token ~2.2x vs fp16 in our setup. But user-facing quality delta is ~3-4 percentage points on the metrics we care about. For revenue-sensitive GTM, I recommend a blended strategy not a full swap.
eva: Product — is a 3–4% instr-follow drop likely to be noticeable? which user cohorts see most impact?

jonah: Short answer: short prompts (<80 tokens) and high-precision tasks (QA, codegen) show the largest delta. Multi-turn, long context convs shrink the gap. If GTM is chat-first, consider route-by-prompt-type.

maya: Proposed lightweight rollout config (canary + conditional routing):
```
route_policy: {
  name: "14b-int8-canary",
  weights: { "14b-fp16": 70, "14b-int8": 30 },
  conditions: [
    { "key": "user_tier", "in": ["free","trial"] },
    { "key": "prompt_len", "lt": 80 }
  ]
}
```

sam: For GTM pricing guidance (quick sketch):
- Self-serve default: int8 as default generation model. Recommend price = baseline_hosted_price * 0.55 (reflects infra savings + margin).
- Premium / Enterprise: flag fp16 opt-in billed at baseline * 1.8 (covers higher infra + SLA).
- Embedding product: if embedding cos-sim drop >3% for critical customers, offer fp16 embedding nodes as add-on.

anya: Add safety net: quality-regression alerting on the eval set + production holdback. If instr-follow drops >2 pts or hallucination +0.8% then auto-scale back traffic to fp16 and page eng-ml.
eval-bot: regression test triggered at 1766000500: instr-follow=86 (delta -2). Flagged and recorded in /evals/2026/14b-v2/int8/regression-1766000500.

miguel: Action items: 1) product (eva) chooses default routing policy + communicate expected UX delta; 2) eng-ml (maya, jonah) implement conditional routing + add canary; 3) econ (sam) finalize pricing multipliers and comms; 4) devex/docs update quickstart mentioning int8 tradeoffs. I'll schedule a 15m sync with GTM.
eva: ack. I'll pick defaults and prep comms for early access customers.

sam: I'll draft a 1-pager with unit econ tables (per-1M tokens) and proposed list price multipliers by EOD.

miguel: Great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
